name: Rust crates for illumos DS-Lite connectivity

mentions.name: Rust crates for illumos DS-Lite connectivity
mentions.description: Two Rust crates published to support connecting an illumos server directly to a Japanese ISP over DS-Lite, handling the tunnel and the DHCPv6 prefix delegation that stock illumos could not manage. The work also involved tracing a four-byte ABI mismatch between a 64-bit Rust process and a 32-bit illumos service, and the experience is documented in a blog post.
mentions.problem: Stock illumos could not manage the DHCPv6 prefix delegation required by the author's ISP connection.
mentions.audience: Explicit personal project: connecting the author's own illumos server to their own Japanese ISP connection.
mentions.source_excerpt: I wanted to connect my illumos server directly to my Japanese ISP through DS-Lite, and ended up writing and publishing two Rust crates along the way.
mentions.author: mskalski
